target_invariant: Operators can inspect runtime progress, failed effects, waits, recovery actions, and alerts through durable machine-readable evidence; failed side effects remain failed/retry/dead-letter until an explicit audited recovery action changes state.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: case timeline records runtime effect state changes and deploy receipts
acceptance_coverage.notes: Timeline emission is idempotency-guarded and carries case/work-item/effect/deploy correlation.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: operators can inspect and act on failed effects and waiting states without hidden-artifact leakage
acceptance_coverage.notes: Monitor recovery lane filters waits and runtime effects through the operator hidden-artifact contract before rendering summaries and actions.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: runtime effect recovery has CLI/API retry, cancel, and dead-letter controls
acceptance_coverage.notes: Recovery mutations require an operator reason and reject active in-flight worker claims.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: recovery actions are audit-linked for success and structured failure paths
acceptance_coverage.notes: Rejected recovery attempts return structured RuntimeEffectRecoveryError details with result=error audit evidence.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: operational alerts flag stuck cases and failed/dead-letter effects with dedupe and recovery correlation
acceptance_coverage.notes: Alerts carry severity, idempotency/dedupe keys, case/effect correlation, evidence, and recovery API paths.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: operator evidence does not claim success for failed or partially recovered effects
acceptance_coverage.notes: Failed/dead-letter statuses remain visible in API, Monitor, timeline, and alerts until an explicit recovery transition is accepted and audited.

review_commands: PATH=/home/ubuntu/.bun/bin:$PATH bun test --timeout 30000 tests/operator-run-observability-closure-report.test.ts tests/runtime-effect-recovery.test.ts tests/runtime-effect-outbox.test.ts tests/operational-alerts.test.ts tests/event-waits-list.test.ts
